tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya ga na ratna bha ya dha ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po rin po che'i 'bru'i dkor mdzod dang*/ 'bru dang longs spyod spel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen mdzod dang gter dbang phyug /'bru drug sbyin dang longs spyod bdag /kun dbang rgyal po 'jig rten dpal// btsun mo legs sbyin dag pa'i dbang*// 'khor bsgyur bran rnams yangs pa'i sbyin// de sogs dpag tu med pa rnams// yid 'thad 'chang 'don rab tu 'grub// mi zad dpag med myur 'grub gsol// oṃ ratna ga na ga na pa ti/ ratna sarba ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ gha gha gha gha/ gha gha gha gha/ na mo na ma ye sa hu/ gzungs 'di'i byin rlabs mthu dbang gis// rin chen nor mdzod gter rnams la// me chu rlung dgra sa g.yos dang*// 'bru nad sad ser rtsa nad 'jigs// pha rol dgra kun ma rung 'tshe// log lta gnod pa thams cad bzlog /oṃ kro ta tsakra/ ra tsa sarba ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ khro rgyal 'khor lo sgyur rgyal gyis// gter dang rin chen 'bru dang mdzod// rgyal po btsun mo 'bangs 'khor bcas// zhing dang lo tog skyed byed tshal// de dag thams cad bsrung du gsol// 'jig rten dbang phyug rin po che// rigs brgyud sbyin dang nor gyi dpal// gang 'dod 'byung dang legs dbang mchog /bkra shis sbyin dang yon tan gter// dkyil 'khor 'grub dang brtul zhugs ldan// gang gis mos phyogs rnams la dge /de dag thams cad myur 'grub shog /oṃ sa manta bha dra ma gha la gha ta swā hā// glang chen dang ni gzhon nu dang*/ mche ba gcig dang phyag bzhi pa// glang sna dang ni mgrin sngon dang*// gsus po tshe dang phag shed dang*// zla mdog dang ni mal gyis gzhon// tshogs bdag dang ni snying rje ldan// 'di rnams mtshan gyis khyod la bstod// 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po dkor mdzod zhing khams thams cad spel zhing bsrung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs le'u bcu drug pa rdzogs so/// /
